# VA Beauty Studio

> Beauty salon in Palma de Mallorca (Ponent): manicure, pedicure, pain-free podology nail care, nail extensions and facial treatments. The team speaks Ukrainian, Spanish, English, German and Russian.

- Address: Carrer Albó 2, local 3, Ponent, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain
- Phone and WhatsApp Business: +34 684 301 949 (https://wa.me/34684301949)
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00–18:00; closed on Sunday
- Booking: online form on the website, WhatsApp or phone; every appointment is confirmed personally
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/va_beauty_studio__/

## Services and starting prices

- Manicure: from €30 (classic, nail polish, gel polish, gel, gel + extensions, French design, spa with paraffin)
- Pedicure: from €50 (full classic pedicure, nail polish, gel polish)
- Nail extensions: from €5 per nail; spot repair
- Removal / correction: from €20 (gel, gel polish)
- Lifting & rejuvenation: from €85 (microneedling with Dermapen, microcurrent, carboxytherapy)
- Hydration & glow: from €65 (needle-free mesotherapy, personalised facial programmes)
- Cleansing & balance: from €55 (Hydrofacial, combined facial cleansing, ultrasonic peel)
- Skin renewal: from €80 (chemical, enzyme and glow peels, micro-exfoliation)
